headline: Copying the scan report now closes it, and the per-sequence button says Select all again
notes: **Copying the scan report closes it.** The only reason to open the report is to send it, so the copy is the end of the job. If the clipboard refuses, it stays open so you can copy it by hand.
**Select all is words again (1.3.1).** The per-sequence button had become a double-tick symbol. The words are back, with the count still on them.
